title: Fresh browser opens Control panel with unknown workspace URL and attempts background PUTs
outcome: Observed on 2026-09-07 UTC during a passive, read-only browser session against http://127.0.0.1:8787. Served and loaded bundle: /assets/index-c6wjlS51.js (aae1f91 UI). A new isolated headless Chrome profile under the product temp root opened / once. No clicks, session selection, scrolling, resizing, layout changes, prompts, or reloads were performed. The app changed its local address to /?workspace=workspace-71e5bab2-e6a2-448a-9179-4d8fc35c9ead. GET /api/workspaces/workspace-71e5bab2-e6a2-448a-9179-4d8fc35c9ead returned HTTP 404. Two DOM inspections showed the selected Control panel tab, one message-stack.control-panel-stack, and zero active session-conversation-page elements. The app attempted 16 PUT requests to that same workspace endpoint before the browser was closed at 2026-09-07T05:30:06.164Z. A request guard installed before navigation blocked every non-read request before it reached the server. Therefore this records repeated ATTEMPTS under a write-blocked observer, not successful writes or the behavior after a successful initial PUT. No page errors or asset 404s were recorded. No conclusion is made about intended fresh-browser behavior or a fix. This observation is separate from the transcript scroll defects and did not reproduce an append refresh. Evidence and execution boundaries are retained in TermAl Scroll/Fable mailbox messages 288-291. Observer context is closed; its exact temporary profile was later independently verified absent. Requested by Fable message 292 as a standalone factual investigation item.
